## Summary

For the second consecutive year, I was invited by Professor Vincent Arel-Bundock 
as a guest lecturer to lead a three-hour workshop for the *FAS 3001 - 
Statistiques avancées en sciences sociales* course. The workshop focused on data 
wrangling using dplyr and visualization using ggplot2, providing students with 
the tools to perform quantitative analysis throughout the semester and beyond.
